title: Restructure Engineer's Notebook
question: Same notebook world and right-edge tabs, three new structures. In all three, the tabs become disciplines, the homepage leads with navigation, and the ground gets a subtle moving paper grain. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Sketch first
options.thesis: The page opens on a big annotated sketch you can drag; the working follows underneath.
options.viewport: A one-line problem, then a full-width beam sketch with load, span and section set directly on the drawing; formula and live answer sit under it.
options.risk: Inputs on the drawing need clear affordances, or people will miss that they can drag.

options.label: Margin notes
options.thesis: One calm column in notebook order, with symbols and units written in the margin beside where they're used.
options.viewport: Problem, then sketch and inputs in the column, then the formula with each symbol defined in the right margin next to it.
options.risk: On phones the margin folds inline, so it needs careful ordering.

options.label: Given / Find
options.thesis: Every topic is a worked problem in the classic engineering format: Given, Find, Sketch, Solution, Answer.
options.viewport: A ruled label gutter on the left. Given (editable values) and Sketch side by side; Solution shows the formula with your numbers substituted; Answer boxed in oxblood.
options.risk: Reads like homework if the copy is too formal.
